perspective:
From Alice Lim’s subjective perspective, she has access to:

- She is a dental hygienist and has been close friends with Austin since high school; they discuss personal/professional lives and support each other. She knows Austin has a separate career path in insurance/office work.
- She noticed Austin becoming reserved when talking about work and suspects something specific is bothering him—possibly that he is hiding something about his job performance.
- Alice invited Austin for coffee. She heard him say it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs, but then admit he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- Alice asked if he had considered changing careers. Austin said he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths to take and asked for suggestions.
- Alice told Austin healthcare needs dedicated people and offered to share her experiences and connect him with contacts. Austin said that sounded interesting and wanted to know more.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant because of fear of risk/the unknown/initial struggle. She felt frustration and empathy. She told him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier, and encouraged him that growth comes from leaving one’s comfort zone and that she supports him.
- Austin thanked her and said it helped to know he had her support and to hear real success stories.
- Seeing Austin open to the discussion, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She offered to connect him with a career counselor and friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections.
- Alice said she would set up a meeting for next week. Austin said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believes Austin is ready to take next steps and appreciates her help. She feels satisfaction and joy.
- Alice told Austin she was proud of the steps he had taken. Austin said he felt excited, nervous, and grateful. Alice suggested regular check-ins; Austin agreed, saying they would keep him focused and that her perspective helps.
- Alice plans to keep regular check-ins with Austin about his progress and challenges.

Alice’s beliefs about Austin’s motives, hesitation, and readiness are based on her observations, what Austin told her, and her own inferences—not on hidden or narrator-only information.
